evidence.title: KPI-Conditioned Generative Design of Automotive Hood Inner Panels: A Two-Stage Retrieval-Generation Pipeline with Surrogate-Based Performance Estimation

summary: Researchers developed a retrieval-generation framework that leverages key performance indicators and surrogate-based estimation to automate the design of automotive hood inner panels. The system combines retrieval of existing designs with generative AI to meet engineering constraints efficiently.
title: AI-Powered Two-Stage Pipeline Optimizes Automotive Hood Design Using KPIs and Surrogate Models
